items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Dorsey, Tommy Dorsey and we used to jam inbetween their shows over at a place called 'The Three Deuces'

ctx.x: Now the other horn you were talking about it's a Bach cornet and Bix Beiderbecke gave me this horn. He bought it for me actually. He was in Chicago with the Paul Whiteman Orchestra there in 1928 this was. And he came in with Paul Whiteman
and Bing Crosby and the Rhythm Boys. Jimmy Dorsey, Tommy Dorsey and we used to jam inbetween their shows over at a place called 'The Three Deuces' 222....
That used to be a famous club.
